tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background and the rail. Everything starts here.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Bottom shelf and other full-width bars, one step above ground.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: The one head-unit panel per page (f-unit). Never nest a panel inside a panel.

tokens.name: lane
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, lanes and clips.

tokens.name: lane-sel
tokens.usage: A picked row, clip or stage: one step up from where it sits, paired with a pick hairline or edge.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Behind drawings: thumbnails, previews, the Bench viewport. One step down from ground.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Names, values and primary text on ground, bar, panel, lane-sel and well (14.8:1 on ground, 12.8:1 on lane-sel).

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Running text and descriptions on ground and panel (11:1 on ground, 10.3:1 on panel).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Labels, units, micro text and secondary values on ground (5.2:1), well (5.4:1) and panel (4.8:1). On lane-sel it falls to 4.48:1, just under 4.5: a picked row's own label switches to ink.

tokens.name: ink-off
tokens.usage: Zero readouts (00) at readout-lg size and disabled controls only: 3.4:1 on ground, 3.2:1 on panel, which passes for 24px+ text and nothing smaller.

tokens.name: ink-ghost
tokens.usage: Unlit meter segments and the face of empty marks. Not text.

tokens.name: line-1
tokens.usage: Row dividers and grids inside a region.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Region borders: column edges, the panel's outline, the top strip.

tokens.name: line-3
tokens.usage: Field borders and dashed empty-lane lines.

tokens.name: line-4
tokens.usage: Button and toggle outlines at rest.

tokens.name: line-5
tokens.usage: Fader tracks, the chain's dashed rail, hovered outlines.

tokens.name: pick
tokens.usage: Signal: the picked thing, keyboard focus, and the one action to take next (outlined go-buttons). One meaning only.

tokens.name: pick-hi
tokens.usage: Hover on a pick-filled control.

tokens.name: pick-dim
tokens.usage: Pick at half strength: secondary pick outlines (edit links in the selection bar).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Signal: up to date, saved, live. Status dots and flags; never a button.

tokens.name: stale
tokens.usage: Signal: stale, broken, thin or clipped. Status flags, stale clips, thin role counts. Never for Clear or Delete buttons (those stay ink-2).

tokens.name: sim
tokens.usage: Signal: a simulation or preview is running (Ecology tank, 3D preview badge).

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a filled signal (an on toggle, a pick-filled button).

tokens.name: trk-1
tokens.usage: Content hue (TAPE 08 track colour). Identifies a thing (a stage, a role, a row); never fills a control or carries state.

families.ui: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: index
styles.usage: The index box and a picked thing's number. Pick colour when picked.

styles.name: readout-lg
styles.usage: Head-unit readouts and row numbers. Always with a unit or a label.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Counts at the end of a track row, secondary readouts.

styles.name: readout-sm
styles.usage: Values beside field labels, meter values, versions.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The head unit's name line. Uppercase.

styles.name: name-fixed
styles.usage: Names Forge owns (stages, roles, chain modules): uppercase, two words at most.

styles.name: name
styles.usage: Names people make (worlds, species, buildings, cities): as typed, never uppercased.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field and section labels. Uppercase, one or two words.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Every button. Uppercase, named by its result.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Meta lines, units under readouts, empty-lane text. Uppercase.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Drift near buildings nudges these by up to 30%.
styles.usage: Running text and hints. Sentence case, never uppercase.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: A world collects what you make in every stage.
styles.usage: Longer explanations: empty states and onboarding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The base step; gaps inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps inside button clusters and between thumbs in a lane.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between a label and its control.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Row padding in lists.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gaps between row columns; the minimum side gutter.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Column padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Panel padding and gaps between regions.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: The page gutter.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chips, tag boxes, meter segments.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Thumbnails, clips, sockets.

tokens.name: radius-btn
tokens.usage: Buttons, toggles, fields.

tokens.name: radius-lane
tokens.usage: Lanes, the viewport stage, previews.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: The index box.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: The head-unit panel: the only panel on a page.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Status dots, badges, rail stage numbers.

tokens.name: target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a primary control (transport-style buttons, the arm-size targets).

tokens.name: target-dense
tokens.usage: Forge addition: list-row actions and secondary buttons inside dense columns.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Width of the stage rail.

tokens.name: strip
tokens.usage: Height of the top strip.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a track row.
